name: HY-Motion: A person stands with feet planted, raises one open hand near the chest, then performs a quick powerful open-palm thrust straight forward, like pushing an invisible object away. Strong torso and shoulder motion, sharp acceleration, brief hold with palm extended, then returns to neutral stance.
